cues.zh: 我听说你三秒钟就能吹好一个气球。
cues.en: You can inflate a balloon in three seconds, I understand.

cues.zh: 那这些毫无经验的孩子得花多久？
cues.en: How long is he gonna take these kids with no experience?

cues.zh: 我们预计他们大概一分钟能吹两到三个。
cues.en: We're figuring that they'll do about 2-3 balloons a minute.

cues.zh: 我从15岁起就干这个了，
cues.en: I've been doing this since I was 15 years old,

cues.zh: 所以拿来对比不太公平，但他们差不多是一分钟两到三个。
cues.en: so it's unfair to compare, but 2-3 balloons a minute.

cues.zh: 每个孩子大概要吹700个左右的气球。
cues.en: Each kid is gonna do about 700 balloons or so.

cues.zh: 我们会在4到6个小时内搞定。
cues.en: And we'll do it in about 4-6 hours.

cues.zh: 大家记住，千万别把车停在广场上，
cues.en: Remember folks, don't park on the square

cues.zh: 因为这个周末这里可不是停车的地方！
cues.en: because this ain't the place for your car this weekend!

cues.zh: 听起来挺有意思的，David。
cues.en: It sounds like fun, David.

cues.zh: 听说可能还会刮北风，
cues.en: I understand we might have a northerly wind, too,

cues.zh: 所以它们最终都会飘到加拿大上空。
cues.en: so they'll all wind up over Canada.

cues.zh: 女士们先生们，我们在克利夫兰市中心现场直播，我是Big Chuck和Lou，
cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, live from downtown Cleveland, it's Big Chuck and Lou

cues.zh: 正在全城最盛大的活动现场为您报道！
cues.en: in front of the biggest happening around!

cues.zh: 我们要讲一件真实发生的事，绝不是凭空编造的。
cues.en: We have a real story to tell you. We're not making this up.

cues.zh: Mary Ellen买了两束气球，要在这里送给John和我。
cues.en: Mary Ellen bought two bunches of balloons to give to John and I here.

cues.zh: 她下来的时候，其中一束气球
cues.en: She came down and one of the bunches of balloons she had

cues.zh: 绑在她手表上，然后松开了，气球把手表带走了！
cues.en: tied to her watch and the opened up and the balloons took it!

cues.zh: 现在正往东边某个地方飘去。所以如果有人发现Mary Ellen的手表
cues.en: It's now going out east somewhere. So if anybody finds Mary Ellen's watch

cues.zh: 像这样绑在一束气球上，如果把它送回电台
cues.en: tied to a bunch of balloons like this and if you return it to the station

cues.zh: 我们会给你各种奖励。
cues.en: we'll have all kind of rewards for you.

cues.zh: 你叫什么名字？Tanya，给大家看看你手上有什么。
cues.en: What is your name? Tanya, show everybody what you have on your hands there.

cues.zh: 那些是绷带。
cues.en: Those are bandages.

cues.zh: 它们是用来干什么的？
cues.en: And what are they for?

cues.zh: 你起水泡了吗？
cues.en: Did you get any blisters?

cues.zh: 起了，三个。
cues.en: Yeah, three.

cues.zh: 我还是觉得他们保持着纪录！交回给你，Chuck！
cues.en: I still think they have the record! Back to you, Chuck!

cues.zh: 这件事从三月就开始规划了
cues.en: This is something that has been in the planning stages since March

cues.zh: 所以做了大量技术研究，还有关于城市许可的研究。
cues.en: So a lot of technical research and research about the city permits.

cues.zh: 他们居然敢尝试搞这种大场面，简直不可思议，
cues.en: It's absolutely astonishing that they would try and get something like this off,

cues.zh: 更别说还是在没等好天气的情况下。
cues.en: let alone waiting for good weather.

cues.zh: 所以这对克利夫兰绝对是个巨大加分项。
cues.en: So this is a big plus for Cleveland.

cues.zh: 今天原本预报有70%的降雨概率，但我认为
cues.en: They predicted 70% chance of showers today and I think this is a

cues.zh: 这正是 United Way 想要展现的绝佳例证，他们在向大家宣告：
cues.en: prime example of what United Way is trying to do in terms of saying,

cues.zh: “克利夫兰，属于你的时刻到了！是时候做出积极回应了！是时候展现这是一座充满活力的城市了！”
cues.en: "Cleveland's it's your time! It's time to say yes! It's time to say it is a happening city!"

cues.zh: 我们正在大步向前，它不再是被人调侃的笑柄。
cues.en: We are on the move. It's no longer the butt of jokes.

cues.zh: 我来这座城市已经6个月了，真的太喜欢这里了。
cues.en: I've been in this city now for 6 months and I absolutely love it.

cues.zh: 我和我妻子甚至商量过搬到这里定居。
cues.en: My wife and I have even talked to moving here.

cues.zh: 我们在洛杉矶的朋友都觉得我们疯了。
cues.en: Our friends in LA think we're nuts.

cues.zh: 但这真是一个很棒的地方。如果我有钱投资，我一定会投在这里。
cues.en: But it is a wonderful place. If I had money to invest, this is where I'd be invested.

cues.zh: 它把整个终端塔（Terminal Tower）都彻底遮住了！
cues.en: It's completely covering the Terminal Tower!

cues.zh: 哇，快看啊！太壮观了！我都想高唱《飞向云霄》了！
cues.en: Ah, look at that! Awesome! I wanna sing, "Up, Up, and Away!"

cues.zh: 此时此刻，五彩斑斓的气球正升向天空！
cues.en: The multi-colors that are going up in the air at this moment!

cues.zh: 让我们为 Cleveland 欢呼吧！
cues.en: Let's hear it for Cleveland!

cues.zh: 女士们先生们，“湖畔犯错之城”的污名彻底成为历史了！
cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, there is no mistake on the lake anymore!

cues.zh: Cleveland 现在打破了吉尼斯世界纪录，
cues.en: Cleveland has now broken the Guinness Book of World Records

cues.zh: 放飞了超过 150 万只气球！
cues.en: and released over 1,500,000 balloons!

cues.zh: 这一切，都发生在这个全美模范城市——俄亥俄州的 Cleveland！
cues.en: All of this, in Cleveland, Ohio! The all-American city!

cues.zh: 新闻主播：对这些海岸警卫队员来说，这是一场令人精疲力竭的搜救。
cues.en: News Anchor: It's been an exhausting search for these Coast Guardsmen.

cues.zh: 他们大半天都在水面上搜寻两名 40 岁的 Cleveland 男子，
cues.en: They've been out on the water most of the day looking for two 40-year-old Cleveland men,

cues.zh: Skip Sullivan 和 Raymond Broderick。他们大约在昨晚强风暴来袭前一小时
cues.en: Skip Sullivan and Raymond Broderick. They went out fishing about an hour

cues.zh: 外出钓鱼。
cues.en: before last night's heavy storm blew through.

cues.zh: 这就是他们的船。船上还留着两件救生衣，
cues.en: This is their boat. A pair of life jackets still in it,

cues.zh: 还有一顶帽子和一根钓竿。船的发动机不见了。
cues.en: along with a hat and a fishing pole. The boat's motor is gone.

cues.zh: 船身两侧有撞击痕迹，显然是整夜撞击防波堤这一段造成的
cues.en: Its sides are battered, apparently from pounding all night against this section of the breakwall

cues.zh: 就在 Edgewater Park 外。今天早上8点半左右，海岸警卫队在那里发现了这艘船。
cues.en: off Edgewater Park. That's where the Coast Guard found the boat about 8:30 this morning.

cues.zh: 讽刺的是，今天克利夫兰那场大型气球放飞活动，正是让这次搜救
cues.en: Ironically that big balloon launch in Cleveland today is one of the things

cues.zh: 对海岸警卫队来说如此艰难的原因之一。
cues.en: that's making this search so tough for the Coast Guard.

cues.zh: 你能想象吗，要在这么多漂浮在水面的气球中找人，甚至发现一件救生衣
cues.en: Can you imagine trying to find somebody floating out here or even spotting a lifejacket

cues.zh: 有多难？
cues.en: with all these balloons on the water?

cues.zh: 这就像大海捞针。
cues.en: It's like trying to find a needle in a haystack.

cues.zh: 你要找的是一个头，或者一件橙色救生衣。
cues.en: You're looking for a head or an orange lifejacket.

cues.zh: 可水面上有几十万个橙色气球。
cues.en: You have a couple hundred thousand orange balloons.

cues.zh: 根本分不清哪个是哪个。
cues.en: It's just hard to decipher which is which.

cues.zh: 受天气影响，放飞的 balloons 有60%落在了这里，而不是原计划的10%。
cues.en: Because of weather, 60% of the balloons launched landed here instead of the planned 10%.

cues.zh: 其中很多最终落在了伊利湖中。
cues.en: Many of them were found on Lake Erie.

cues.zh: 周六覆盖湖面并引发担忧的气球
cues.en: The balloons that covered the lake and caused concern on Saturday

cues.zh: 今天已经不在这里了。
cues.en: are no longer here today.

cues.zh: 没人确切知道它们去了哪里，
cues.en: No one's quite sure where they went

cues.zh: 但至少它们不再对鱼类和野生动物构成威胁，
cues.en: but at least they're no longer posing a threat to fish and wildlife

cues.zh: 也没有继续污染湖泊了。
cues.en: and they're not littering the lake.

cues.zh: Michelle Holden，5台现场报道。
cues.en: Michelle Holden live on five.
